question: Should omitted iOS share attachments always block sending, and should the macOS test-timeout adjustment remain in this PR?
rationale: Failing closed intentionally changes an existing workflow, while the cross-platform test change is outside the stated bug boundary; those choices require maintainer intent rather than automated inference.

options.title: Land focused fail-closed fix
options.body: Keep omission blocking, refresh exact-head native proof, and remove or separately justify the macOS timeout adjustment.

options.title: Allow warned partial sends
options.body: Permit supported attachments to send after a clear warning, requiring revised product behavior, tests, and runtime proof.

options.title: Pause for full attachment support
options.body: Defer the blocker until video and file transport is designed, leaving the current silent omission unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land focused fail-closed fix
recommendation.body: Keep omission blocking, refresh exact-head native proof, and remove or separately justify the macOS timeout adjustment.

likelyOwner.reason: They rewrote the current implementation and introduced the additional scope, so they are the best available owner for the compatibility and scope decision.
